concepts.gloss_en: Elohim/Elokim — the Divine Name connoting judgment (din), associated with Malkhut and constricted consciousness (katnut)

reason_for_human: Every one of the 11 occurrences is the Divine Name Elohim, consistently glossed as the aspect of din/judgment (tied to Malkhut and katnut ha-mochin). The surface variation אֱלֹקִים vs אֱלֹהִים is only the pious ק-for-ה substitution for the divine name, not a different word — no homograph here. This is a single concept.
